name: General Ability (all PPSC posts)
dept: Common to most PPSC MCQ tests
summary: The shared core of PPSC recruitment tests. Master this and you are ready for Junior Clerk, Assistant, Deputy Accountant and the general half of many other papers.

syllabus.label: General Ability
syllabus.note: General Knowledge, Pakistan Studies, Current Affairs, Islamic Studies (GK for non-Muslims), Geography, Basic Mathematics, English, Urdu, Everyday Science and Basic Computer Studies.

name: Junior Clerk
summary: The most advertised PPSC post. One MCQ paper: 80% General Ability and about 20% MS Office and computer skills, followed by a typing and proficiency test.

syllabus.label: General Ability
syllabus.note: General Knowledge, Pakistan Studies, Current Affairs, Islamic Studies (GK for non-Muslims), Geography, Basic Mathematics, English, Urdu and Everyday Science.

syllabus.label: MS Office and computer skills
syllabus.note: Questions on MS Office and computer skills.

stages: Only those who qualify the General Ability test are called for the English typing and proficiency test (shortlisting ratio 1:20 in several advertisements)

Deputy Commissioner Office, Kot Addu (Board of Revenue)
DC / District Collector Office, Faisalabad (Board of Revenue)

faq_extra: Is there a typing test for Junior Clerk?
Yes. The syllabi say only candidates who qualify the written General Ability test are called for the English typing and proficiency test. Practise typing on a computer alongside MCQs.

name: Assistant
dept: Deputy Commissioner offices / Board of Revenue
summary: A single General Ability MCQ paper that includes Basic Computer Studies. No fixed subject split is printed, so all subjects matter.

syllabus.label: General Ability
syllabus.note: General Knowledge, Pakistan Studies, Current Affairs, Islamic Studies (GK for non-Muslims), Geography, Basic Mathematics, English, Urdu, Everyday Science and Basic Computer Studies.

ads.where: DC / District Collector Office, Faisalabad (Board of Revenue)

name: Deputy Accountant

syllabus.label: General Ability

name: Deputy Director (Environment, Climate Change, Strategy & Policy)
dept: Punjab Environment Protection and Climate Change Department
summary: 50% General Ability and 50% environmental laws, rules and policies (a long list is printed in the syllabus).

syllabus.label: General Ability
syllabus.note: General Knowledge, Pakistan Studies, Current Affairs, Islamic Studies (GK for non-Muslims), Geography, Basic Mathematics, English, Urdu, Everyday Science and Basic Computer Studies.

name: Child Protection Officer

syllabus.label: General Ability (as seen in a comparable CPO paper)
syllabus.note: Current affairs, Pakistan Studies, English, Urdu, computer, maths and Islamic Studies.

syllabus.label: Child protection subject area (possible)
syllabus.note: The Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act 2004, child rights, social work, psychology and criminology.
